notes: Redesigned the Downloads header into one compact control bar; maintenance actions now live under More instead of a large two-row button panel.
Rebuilt Watch List as progress cards with clear remaining-episode status and direct actions instead of an admin-style table.
Watch List Search now performs a fresh targeted Nyaa search only for missing episodes; an 11/12 item searches E12 directly while preserving saved Group/Uploader and Dub preferences.
Enlarged the visible Windows system icon artwork so the taskbar/tray mark occupies the same visual footprint as other application icons.
Episode deep-search now merges both SxxExx and loose episode-number query forms instead of stopping after the first matching release group.
